name: Canada Nature Fund for Aquatic Species at Risk
summary: Multi-year, multi-partner stewardship projects that recover and protect aquatic species at risk in Canada, with about $15.5 million a year available in the fourth round (2027-2031). Indigenous-led projects are prioritised.

status.quote: Funding is now available for projects that can be completed by March 31, 2031.

deadline.quote: by November 16, 2026, at 23:59 (Pacific time). Proposals received after this time will not be considered.

pool.quote: A total of $15.5 million is available under the program each fiscal year of this round.

applicant_types.quote: Research, academic and educational institutions Canadian individuals For-profit organizations, such as small businesses with less than 500 employees, companies, corporations, and industry associations Local organizations such as community associations and groups

access.quote: project leads must complete a project proposal form and email it to the regional coordinator in the region in which the proposed project will be implemented

window.quote: Funding is now available under the fourth round of CNFASAR (2027-2031).

amount.quote: Projects are generally expected to range from $500,000 to $5 million in total, over 4 years.

geography.quote: Other costs that support the conservation and protection of Canada's fish, fish habitat, and aquatic species at risk
